drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 defines a distinct locus: a job may be executed at most three times in total, counting the first attempt, with no further attempt started after the third ends without success.
drafts.subject: Orion job execution attempts

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B01 requires a fixed five-second wait from the end of a failed attempt before the next delivery, not varied by attempt number.
drafts.subject: Orion job retry

drafts.rationale: EV-O-C01 bounds each attempt at thirty seconds of execution and records a reached timeout as a failed attempt.
drafts.subject: Orion execution attempt

drafts.rationale: EV-O-D01 requires further deliveries of an already-active job id to be ignored without changing the active job's state.
drafts.subject: Orion job delivery

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E01 requires each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after first seen, after which a later same-key delivery is treated as new.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency key

drafts.rationale: EV-O-F01 sets a worker lease at sixty seconds from delivery and makes the job available to other workers if the lease expires without renewal or release.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-G01 specifies that a worker may renew a lease every thirty seconds and that a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the renewal moment.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H01 forbids starting future attempts after cancellation while requiring an already-running attempt to run to its own completion, failure, or timeout.
drafts.subject: Orion job cancellation

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I01 requires automatic movement to the dead-letter queue after the last unsuccessful attempt, with no further execution unless explicitly resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job final failure

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J01 requires an operator escalation when three dead-letter events occur for the same tenant within one hour measured from the first of those events.
drafts.subject: Orion tenant dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K01 guarantees FIFO execution only among jobs in the same queue partition and makes no ordering guarantee across partitions.
drafts.subject: Orion queue execution

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L01 requires audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded and allows deletion thereafter.
drafts.subject: Orion audit events

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 requires that a job be executed at most three times in total, counting the first execution, and forbids starting further executions after a third unsuccessful attempt.
EV-O-B01 requires a wait of exactly five seconds from the end of a failed attempt before every retry, and forbids changing that wait based on attempt number.
EV-O-C01 requires each execution attempt to time out after thirty seconds of execution and to be recorded as a failed attempt.

drafts.predicate: handling of further deliveries with the same job id
drafts.rationale: EV-O-D01 requires duplicate deliveries of an active job id to be ignored without changing the active job's state.

value.text: While a job with a given job id is active, any further delivery carrying the same job id must be ignored and must not change the state of the active job.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E01 requires each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen, after which a later delivery with that key is treated as new.
EV-O-F01 requires a worker lease to last sixty seconds from delivery; if it expires without renewal or release, the job becomes available to other workers.
EV-O-G01 allows renewal every thirty seconds during progressing work and requires each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from the renewal moment.

value.text: A worker may renew its lease every thirty seconds while work on the job is progressing, and each renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.predicate: effect on future and in-flight attempts
drafts.rationale: EV-O-H01 forbids starting further attempts after cancellation while requiring any already running attempt to continue to completion, failure, or timeout.

value.text: After a job is cancelled, no future execution attempt may be started, but an already running attempt is not interrupted and runs to its own completion, failure, or timeout.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I01 requires automatic movement to the dead-letter queue after the last unsuccessful attempt and forbids further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt, Orion must automatically move the job to the dead-letter queue, and a job there must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J01 requires an operator escalation when three dead-letter events for the same tenant occur within one hour of the first of those events.

value.text: When three dead-letter events occur for the same tenant within one hour measured from the first of the three events, Orion must raise an operator escalation.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K01 limits FIFO execution-order guarantees to jobs in the same queue partition and states that no ordering is guaranteed across partitions.

value.text: First-in-first-out execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering guarantee is made between jobs in different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L01 requires audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded, after which they may be deleted.
